data.description: The Step Trainer is a stair-climbing machine with two orange foot pedals. The user holds the handles and presses each pedal down in turn, as if climbing steps, which works the thighs, calves and hips and gets the heart going. The pace is set by the user, so it suits both fitter adults and people building up their stamina. Housing societies in high-rise buildings often like it, because it gives the stair-climbing workout without using the building's stairwell. The Step Trainer belongs to our Fun Fitness range and is finished in Play Orange. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. Standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, which we will confirm with your quote.

items.pText: The Step Trainer is a stair-climbing machine with two orange foot pedals. The user holds the handles and presses each pedal down in turn, as if climbing steps, which works the thighs, calves and hips and gets the heart going. The pace is set by the user, so it suits both fitter adults and people building up their stamina. Housing societies in high-rise buildings often like it, because it gives the stair-climbing workout without using the building's stairwell. The Step Trainer belongs to our Fun Fitness range and is finished in Play Orange. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. Standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, which we will confirm with your quote.

The pedals move up and down on pivots, and those pivots are where wear shows first. Inspect them and the pedal surfaces at each service. We install the Step Trainer self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Keep the pedals clear of mud so feet do not slip.
